title: 7.12. Parittattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Naparittaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… namahaggataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… naappamāṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā bāttiṁsa, ārammaṇe sattavīsa, adhipatiyā sattavīsa …pe… aññamaññe tiṁsa …pe… purejāte āsevane catuvīsa …pe… avigate bāttiṁsa.
